# uACPI source provenance

Upstream: https://github.com/uACPI/uACPI

Pinned commit: `f5f6cc29f85dd5db0dd79c47700c8f3ebce18be4`

Retrieved 2026-09-15 through the GitHub archive API. Only `include/`, `source/`,
and the upstream LICENSE are imported; no upstream binaries are executed.
These files are unmodified. LogitOS adaptations live in `c/drivers/power/`.

The full interpreter is built, including conventional ACPI event and sleep
support. This is not the reduced-hardware or table-only configuration.
